subject: tf-sh
title: TF.SH.-----POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 431 (MP(I)-5). TF-SH (transfer shifts) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From SPT-DY: ATTC (attachment). From ALT-F: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From ATTC: F (form). From T-C-IMP: TR-INFO (trans-information). From MT-INFO: AF-NT (affinity nature) and SOC-RT-INTR (social reality interpretation). From TR-INFO: VT-IMP (vibrational implications).
